verdict.rationale: Sill's own repo documents running the Mac host from the command line (`swift run -c release SillHost`). A `--synthetic` flag streams a test pattern without needing Screen Recording, which hints at a GUI-less mode a CI job could invoke. That is only a thin, developer-oriented mention, not a documented headless or CI automation workflow. Homebrew install and nightly builds are distribution channels, not headless operation, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented headless/CI usage guidance, a scriptable CLI or automation interface for controlling sessions, non-interactive pairing or configuration, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: `swift run -c release SillHost` runs the same host on the command line
With `--synthetic` it streams a test pattern with no Screen Recording needed.
